Mutations.ChaosSpawn: {name} now has more {nature} mutations than their {bonus} and becomes a mindless Chaos Spawn.
Mutations.Chosen: {name} loses {loss} Corruption and is Chosen by {patron}. Future mutations use that patron's table.
Mutations.ChosenUnassigned: {name} loses {loss} Corruption and is Chosen by Chaos. No patron was selected; one must be chosen before the next mutation roll.
Mutations.DarkDealUsed: {name} takes a Dark Deal, gains 1 Corruption ({corruption}/{maximum}), and rerolls the Endurance Test.
Mutations.Error: The Mutant's Handbook mutation workflow could not finish: {message} Fix the issue, then change Corruption again to retry.
Mutations.FortuneRerollUsed: {name} spends 1 Fortune to reroll the Endurance Test and has {remaining} remaining.
Mutations.FortuneSLUsed: {name} spends 1 Fortune to add +1 SL to the Endurance Test and has {remaining} remaining.
Mutations.FortuneUnavailable: {name} no longer has a Fortune point available; choose another option.
Mutations.Gained: {name} loses {loss} Corruption and gains the {mutation} mutation.
Mutations.PatronPrompt: {name} is Chosen by Chaos. Choose the patron whose mutation table they will use from now on.
Mutations.PatronRequired: Choose a Chaos patron for {name} before rolling another mutation.
Mutations.PossessedRemoved: Becoming Chosen removes {name}'s possessing daemon. Possessed is now excluded from mutation counts; update any manually applied effects.
Mutations.RepeatPending: {name} loses {loss} Corruption, but the repeated {mutation} result was left for the GM to resolve.
Mutations.RepeatPrompt: {name} already has {mutation}. Mutations repeat by default, but some individual descriptions limit or prohibit another occurrence. Add another copy?
Mutations.ResiliencePrompt: {name} rolled {mutation}. Spend 1 Resilience to avoid it? Corruption is still reduced.
Mutations.Resisted: {name} spends 1 Resilience and avoids {mutation}, but still loses {loss} Corruption.
Mutations.SpeciesRequired: Choose a Mutant's Handbook species profile for {name} to finish the mutation roll.
Mutations.TestResourcesPrompt: {name} failed the Challenging Endurance Test. Use any normal post-roll resources now; accepting the failure starts the Mutant's Handbook mutation procedure.
Mutations.TestResourcesSuccessPrompt: {name} passed the Challenging Endurance Test. Accept the result, spend Fortune for +1 SL, or take a Dark Deal before the test is finalized.
Mutations.UnknownSpeciesPrompt: {name}'s species ({species}) is not one of the Mutant's Handbook profiles. Choose the profile to use for this roll.

MutantsHandbook.Hint: Replaces WFRP4e's standard Dissolution of Body and Mind result with the Ratter #11 Mutant's Handbook procedure when a character exceeds their Corruption threshold.
MutantsHandbook.Name: Use The Mutant's Handbook mutation rules
